chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAbdillāh, from Ayyūb ibn Nūḥ, who said:
He (عليه السلام) sneezed one day while I was with him, so I said, "May I be made your ransom, what is said to the Imam when he sneezes?" He said, "They say: 'May Allah send blessings upon you.'"

key_terms.جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ: may I be made your ransom; an expression of devotion and respect
key_terms.صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ: may Allah send blessings upon you; the response to the Imam's sneeze
key_terms.لِلْإِمَامِ: to the Imam; referring to the proper address directed toward the Imam
key_terms.يُقَالُ: is said; the prescribed wording to be spoken

ai.seo_question: What should be said to the Imam when he sneezes?
ai.summary: This hadith records the etiquette of addressing the Imam (عليه السلام) when he sneezes. It teaches that one should respond with a prayer invoking Allah's blessings upon him, reflecting reverence and proper conduct toward the Imam.
